title: Sicurre ML deployment manifest
description: Runtime identity snapshot. Model version maps to the resolved Hugging Face commit; code, training dataset, and container identities remain separate. Unknown fields represent missing evidence, not a verified release.

version.description: Service/code release version, independent of model version.
Readable model version label from MODEL_VERSION; pair with revision, not the MLflow registry number.

requested_revision.description: Configured Hugging Face reference. Production should pin the immutable commit rather than a mutable tag.

revision.description: Resolved Hugging Face commit SHA reported by the loaded model runtime, or unknown before identity is available.

version.description: Frozen training dataset version, or unknown if lineage is missing. Never substitute a model SHA or evaluation-set version.

revision.description: Deployment/build revision, normally the source Git commit used as the image tag.

container_image_digest.description: Immutable container image digest (sha256), or unknown if not supplied. This is not the model commit.
